research_archive.description: Historical ALFRED as-of snapshot archive documented in repository; primary provider values not independently re-attested

limitations: Stage percentages measure completion of 6 documented project milestones, not model accuracy or validated index completeness.
One ALFRED ZIP archive supports three candidate node mappings; those mappings are not independent node stress scores.
No historical series or observations are fabricated or backfilled.
AICS=NA and predictive_skill=NA unless separate independent scientific gates pass.

The Insurers raw IR archive was downloaded from GitHub Actions and all 4 HTML SHA-256 values independently recalculated. This is only archive-stage evidence, not historical PIT or model scoring; GitHub artifact retention is 30 days.

Neoclouds and SPV receive raw-archive milestone only: 7 original CoreWeave/Nebius/Equinix IR pages were independently downloaded from Actions and rehashed. The legal structure of a true SPV is not established; files have 30-day artifact retention.

Seven current issuer IR reports and seven official IR homepages independently SHA256 rechecked. Hyperscalers, Semiconductors Supply, and AI Demand stage 2 only; Alphabet IR HTML is a shell and must be paired with original PDF. No SEC historical vintage or node score.
